A fixture release: one thing added and one fixed. See [the guide](https://github.com/octo/widgets/blob/v0.2.0/docs/x.md#a),
[an absolute link](https://example.org/y) and [an anchor](#v010).

### Upgrading from v0.1.0

- **Move the files first.** The commands are in
  [the deployment guide](https://github.com/octo/widgets/blob/v0.2.0/docs/deployment.md#moving-the-files).

```bash
# Upgrading by hand is a comment in a code block, not a heading
docker compose up -d
```

#### If it goes wrong

- Restore the snapshot.

Everything, entry by entry: https://github.com/octo/widgets/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md
